freePlan.limits: 1M function invocations/month, 1M edge requests/month, 100 GB data transfer/month.

keyLimits.en: 1M function invocations/month, 1M edge requests/month, 100 GB data transfer/month; cannot purchase extra usage beyond caps.
Includes $20 monthly usage credit; 10M edge requests/month then $2 per 1M; 1TB data transfer/month then $0.15/GB.
Custom limits, advanced security/compliance (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS), dedicated support and SLAs.

cautions.en: Pro plan usage beyond the included $20 credit is billed per unit (e.g. $2 per extra 1M edge requests, $0.15/GB beyond 1TB transfer), so real cost depends on traffic.

capabilities.en: Frontend deployment platform with git-based deploys, preview environments and edge network delivery.
Serverless and edge functions billed on the Pro plan with a default $20 usage credit.
Spend management with a default $200 usage budget, notifications and optional hard limits.
Paid custom build machines available at $0.007 to $0.105 per minute depending on machine type.

limitations.en: Hobby plan cannot purchase additional usage beyond its included caps once exceeded.
Hobby plan is limited to 3 custom firewall rules and has no webhook triggers.
No stated free trial for Pro; usage-based overage costs on Pro can be unpredictable for traffic spikes.

reason.en: Direct competitor with a similar git-based deploy workflow and comparable free tier.
Broader PaaS alternative for full backend apps rather than frontend-focused deployments.

unknowns: Exact number of team seats included by default on the Pro plan before per-seat billing kicks in was not stated on the pricing page.
